CRITICAL_REGRESSION_HANDLING: any supported A_BETTER result on a critical dimension is a critical B regression and blocks pass
MULTI_SAMPLE_AGGREGATION_RULE: per dimension, take the median ordinal relation only when both evaluators agree on direction or at least 4 of 6 evaluator-by-batch votes support it; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
PAIR_DISPOSITION_RULE: per evaluator and dimension, freeze one ordinal relation for each anonymous matched pair
VARIANCE_HANDLING: high dispersion or evaluator disagreement yields INCONCLUSIVE
